notes.title: Steam Achievements - 0.8.1
notes.content:
Steam Achievements

 Desolation now features Steam Achievements that's obtainable while playing the game. There's only 7 for now, even though some of them are rather hard to achieve. More to come :)

notes.title: v0.8.0 - Polishing Update
notes.content:
Features

 Intro cutscene for 'Wanridge City' mission is now skippable.
 The 'Wanridge City' map features more content with models to make the map fuller. More foliage, etc.
 A new initlization system to ensure faster loading times after the first initial startup. Startup may take longer than usual.


Improvements

 The game has gotten a revamp look with a more whole visual identity for the color scheme & fonts.
 The atmosphere has been reworked.
 Sound design has been reworked to create a more immersive experience.
 Decreased loading times.
 Upon picking up a note it'll automatically adjust its size to a readable one upon interacting.
 Bootscreen has been remade.
 Updated the textures of certain models to make them fit into the world more.
 Increased the vision of the flashlight, in terms of intensity and outer scope of the actual cone.


Bug fixes

 Fixed a bug where Patient Zero would stand still if only one player went in an unreachable area.
 Fixed a bug where some doors may have gotten an 'test interact' prompt.
 Fixed a bug where some doors may have gotten out of sync for players.
 Fixed a bug where you would change your item in hand while trying to interact with the drum kit if you were in range.

notes.title: v0.7.5 - Optimization
notes.content:
Optimization

 We have done some lighting changes towards the map to increase the FPS on low-end & mid-end computers. Expect a increase in FPS.

notes.title: v0.7.4
notes.content:
Improvements

 You now need to hold to crouch instead of it being a toggle.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where you could not see anything if you crouched without holding an item.
 Fixed a bug where you were not able to uncrouch.

notes.title: Patch Note v0.7.3 - Equipment System
notes.content:
Equippable Items
[olist]
 Geiger Counter
 Compass
[/olist]

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where ||screamers|| could spawn on the same location.
 Fixed a bug where 0-7 players could be selected when hosting a game. (Changed to 0-6)

notes.title: v0.7.2
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where knocked down players may be jittery.
 Fixed a bug where flashlight would not function properly looking upwards.
 Fixed a bug where the host could not sprint before stamina was fully regenerated.
 Fixed a bug where the notes would collide with the camera.
 Fixed a bug where screamers would detect knocked down players.


Improvements

 Improved first person camera.


Optimization

 Done some further networking optimization to ensure a smoother experience.

notes.title: v0.7.1
notes.content:
Improvements

 Flashlight will now automatically disable upon picking up a note if active.
 A note instruction screen pops up as you pick up a note.
 You are now able to crawl when you are knocked down.

notes.title: Completely Remade Desolation
notes.content:
Dear Steam Community,

First off we wanted to say thankyou to everyone who took interest in our passion project, Desolation. Whilst the inital build of the game was very early, we have been working hard to make sure the update takes on board the advise we have recieved from those playing. With this i am proud to say that we have rebuilt the game from the ground up. We always said we wanted to make games people wanted to play and with this i truly hope you will all enjoy the world and game a lot more.

With the gameplay completely changed and the map changed to incorporate a 'less is more' attitude at the advise of those playing the previous build, causing the game to be more balanced, run better and be less of a confusing experience. 

We hope you are as excited as we are with this update. It truly takes a lot of time to work on these things and we are looking forward to adding even more to the game in future updates (which we endeavour will take a lot less time than this one!)

Take this update as a reset for Desolation. We are learning everyday and have much more plans for the future of the game so please let us know any suggestions or complaints you have, we will be glad to listen to all of them! I know myself that the game had a lot of issues in the previous build and we have worked to ensure all of these have been picked up. 

Once again, thankyou for working with us through this. We are a small team of 3 and truly love working on games so it's a dream come true for us. Keep an eye out for much more coming in the future for us. 

Cheers,

notes.title: Desolation V2.0 PART 1
notes.content:
FIRST MAJOR GAME UPDATE - DESOLATION v2.0 PART 1

Thank you all for being so patient whilst we have been working through the criticisms and advice we have received from the community. We are really pleased to be able to give you all the first major update to Desolation, including some MAJOR changes to the backend systems. 

We hear you. The game at release definitely had some work needed and we are pleased to offer this update, V2.0 as the first attempt into making this game as good as it can be. 

Please continue to give us your opinions while we are in early access we are listening to everyone! Desolation as our first game has been amazing and we have learnt a lot about what needs to be done to continue working and improving upon the game, we have SO MUCH planned. You guys have been incredible with helping us test and work through the issues, here’s the changes in the most recent update. 
 
Bug Fixes

 AI's could not see you.
 Crow sounds were really loud.
 AI's would not attack you.
 AI's could not see multiplayer players.
 AI's could be T-Posing occasionally.
 Joining the game after the game has started would break the game.
 Not everyone would get the voice acting on start.
 Syncing errors with widgets.
 Bombs would not be synced if players were too far apart.
 Everyone would get a sound played on their side if someone got chased by a zombie.
 If AI attacked as players left it would go in an infinite loop.
 AI would lose track of you while you being in sight.
 Objectives would not sync network wise.
 You could not assign max players for a lobby.
 When you died you would start flying.


Improvements

 Improved the sounds of the zombies. (In-world sounds that actually comes from the zombies)
 Redesigned the whole UI system.
 Optimized the entire map.
 Made the map smaller in size.
 Camera is now smoother.
 Flashlight delays after rotation.
 Revamped every backend system that builds up the foundation of Desolation to perform better.
 Pickup notification when you pick up an item.
 "Progress story" pop up when you reach a story item you can't use yet to avoid confusion.
 Attack indication around screen.
 Added a fade in as the game loads in
 Made every UI item spawn in naturally with animations.
 Added a cutscene at the start.
 Multiplayer rework.
 Day and night cycle has been reworked.
 Improved fog and atmosphere of the game.
 Added ambiance soundtracks and sounds.
 Startup screen of the game has been revamped.
 Animations is added to the menus.
 Loading screen system has been redeveloped.
 Endings are now reworked and works correctly.


Added

  LOBBY SYSTEM
   - There is now a lobby system to make everyone ready to go into the world of desolation.


  PROXIMITY VOICE CHAT
    - You are now able to talk with your fellow mates through the voice chat in game.


  MAX PLAYERS & NOT ABLE TO JOIN IN-GAME LOBBIES
    - You are now able to set an actual max amount of players for your lobby and you will not be able to join in-game lobbies.


 SETTINGS MENU
    - We have now after high demand finally implemented a more detailed settings menu, where you are able to change settings. This one is still under testing and is only available from IN GAME. If you find any issues let us know.


Coming next we have the ‘part 2’ of V2.0 which will include more MAJOR changes to the game and even new enemies, endings and more. Thanks again for all the patience whilst we continue to work on the game. 

Discord: https://discord.gg/HnuavHPSKQ

notes.title: Desolation v1.1 - State of the Game
notes.content:
Ever since the release we've been working hours on hours on perfecting and fixing every bug, so with that we've just released our official roadmap for the planned updates.

So the first planned update is called "Desolation v1.1", it will revamp all of the systems, make it more bug free, feature more content, make it more enjoyable, smoother, have UI redesigns and such.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574939/3f39722743088e53a5b511745730270621173822.png

THANK YOU
Thank you everyone to playing the game and leaving your feedback. It really helps with development. Thank you guys, and I can't wait to share this update when we get the chance!
